content: Command of the Message (Force Management): Before/After scenario contrast, Required Capabilities (functional needs mapped to buyer problems, not product features), Metrics (quantified proof, unverifiable claims without a metric are unconvincing), Proof Points (a specific story with numbers in a recognizable context, not a logo wall), Differentiators (unique = only you; comparative = others have it too but you do it measurably better), Positive Business Outcomes (PBOs). Cross-checked across forcemanagement.com and 4 independent secondary sources.
